name: deleted-flag-branch
description: A feature-flag branch is deleted along with the flag check, so behavior that used to be gated now always runs. Blind-spot axis: deletions that silently change behavior.

expectedFinding.summary: Removing the `exportV2Enabled` gate makes the V2 path unconditional and deletes the V1 fallback. Any environment still relying on V1 (or with the flag off) silently switches to V2 with no migration path.
